title: 농림축산식품부장관의 소속 청장에 대한 지휘에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 농림축산식품부장관의 소속 청장에 대한 지휘에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 5 (Meetings of Planning and Coordination Officers of Affiliated Agencies) Where necessary to consult on work among the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Rural Development Administration, and the Korea Forest Service, or to coordinate matters concerning the formulation of major policies, the Director General of the Planning and Coordination Office of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may, under the orders of the Minister, convene a meeting of planning and coordination officers of affiliated agencies, in which the planning and coordination officers of the Rural Development Administration and the Korea Forest Service participate. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
